reason: The patch changes the ticker to 1 minute at pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:77 but leaves `const timeout = 9 * time.Minute` at cleanup.go:89, so a run may last up to 9 ticker periods. Runs cannot truly overlap, because `srv.clean(ctx)` is called synchronously in the ticker loop (cleanup.go:80-81), but a run longer than a minute is followed immediately by the next one via the buffered tick, so the back-to-back half of the claim holds.
